claims.evidence: The logbook makes no mention of RoVid-X, its 4M-video scale, 1300+ skills, 720P resolution, optical flow, or caption properties; the dataset is never addressed.

raw_verdict.overall: This CPU-only artifact audit confirms the structural dimensions of RBench (five tasks, four embodiments) and the count of 25 leaderboard entries, but does not rerun any experiments and leaves the Spearman correlation, RoVid-X dataset properties, and named failure modes unaddressed. It is a limited provenance check rather than a functional reproduction.
